q: 外面雨太大，我什么都看___见。
en: The rain outside is so heavy that I can't see anything.

q: 我鼻子堵住了，什么味道都闻___到。
en: My nose is blocked; I can't smell anything.

q: 雾这么大，前面的路我看___清楚。
en: The fog is so thick that I can't see the road ahead clearly.

q: 雪停了，路上的车终于开___动了。
en: The snow has stopped, and the cars can finally move again.

q: 医生说的话，我一句也没听___。
en: I didn't understand a single sentence the doctor said.

q: 我太累了，爬___上去了。
en: I'm too tired; I can't climb up any more.

q: 我的腿受伤了，站___起来。
en: My leg is injured and I can't stand up.

q: 年纪大了，他的名字我怎么也想___起来了。
en: I'm getting old; I just can't recall his name any more.

q: 别担心，这点雨不大，我们走___回去。
en: Don't worry, this rain isn't heavy; we can walk back.

q: 风太大了，我们的帐篷怎么也搭___起来。
en: The wind is so strong that we just can't get our tent up.

q: 我肚子疼，一口饭也吃___。
en: My stomach hurts; I can't get down a single bite.

q: 已经七点五十了，八点的飞机，现在去机场___了。
en: It is already ten to eight and the flight is at eight; it's too late to go to the airport now.

q: 你别急，现在出门还___。
en: Don't worry; if you leave now there is still time.

q: 天气预报说一小时后会下大雨，我们现在跑回家还___。
en: The forecast says heavy rain in an hour; if we run home now we can still make it.

q: 冬天的大衣太贵了，他买___。
en: Winter coats are too expensive; he can't afford one.

q: 空调都卖完了，我们哪儿都买___。
en: The air conditioners are all sold out; we can't buy one anywhere.

q: 晚上咖啡喝多了，我怎么也睡___。
en: I drank too much coffee in the evening and can't fall asleep no matter what.

q: 我刚吃完饭，再好吃的蛋糕也吃___了。
en: I just finished eating; I couldn't manage any more, however nice the cake.

q: 这个西瓜太大了，我们三个人吃两天也吃___。
en: This watermelon is so big that three of us couldn't finish it in two days.

q: 明天下大雪，我们去___。
en: It's going to snow heavily tomorrow, so we can't go.

q: 我胃不好，太辣的菜我吃___。
en: My stomach is bad; I can't eat very spicy food.

q: 今年冬天太冷了，我真受___。
en: This winter is so cold that I really can't stand it.

q: 下雨天路滑，山路根本走___，还是别去了。
en: The road is slippery in the rain and the mountain path is impossible to walk; let's not go.

q: 那年冬天的第一场雪，我永远忘___。
en: I will never forget the first snow of that winter.

q: 你一个人拿得___这么多东西吗？
en: Can you carry this many things by yourself?

q: 医生说你感冒了，今天___去游泳。
en: The doctor says you have a cold, so you must not go swimming today.

q: 病人刚睡着，你们___大声说话。
en: The patient has just fallen asleep; you mustn't talk loudly.

q: 这个箱子里装满了书，太重了，我一个人搬___。
en: This box is full of books and too heavy; I can't lift it by myself.

q: 医生说你的腿还没好，现在___爬山。
en: The doctor says your leg isn't better yet, so you shouldn't climb mountains now.

q: 他的腿骨折了，现在站___，更不用说走路了。
en: His leg is broken; he can't even stand up now, let alone walk.

q: 台风来了，学校通知今天___出门。
en: A typhoon is coming; the school has notified everyone not to go out today.

q: 这里是病房，晚上八点以后外人___进去。
en: This is a ward; outsiders may not go in after eight at night.

q: 他的汉字写___很好，老师很喜欢。
en: He writes Chinese characters very well, and the teacher likes them.

q: 昨天雨太大，路灯又坏了，司机开车开___很慢。
en: Yesterday the rain was heavy and the street lights were out, so the driver drove very slowly.

q: 我今天嗓子哑了，再怎么用力也唱___好。
en: My throat is hoarse today, so I can't sing well however hard I try.

q: 我想不起来___他的名字了。
en: I can't remember his name any more.

q: 这本医学书太难了，我___看不懂。
en: This medical book is too hard; I can't understand it.

q: 他说得太快，他的话我___。
en: He speaks too fast; I can't understand what he says.

q: 风声太大了，你听___见我说话吗？
en: The wind is loud; can you hear me?

q: 雨这么大，你走___走得回去？
en: The rain is so heavy; can you walk back?

q: 老师，这么多新词，我们一个晚上记___记得住？
en: Teacher, can we remember this many new words in one evening?

q: 外面太吵，朋友问我听得见吗，我说听___见。
en: It was too noisy; my friend asked if I could hear, and I said I couldn't.

q: 这个药的说明这么小，你看得清楚看___清楚？
en: The instructions on this medicine are so small; can you read them clearly or not?

q: 他的病这么重，明天来得了来___？
en: He is so ill; can he come tomorrow or not?

q: 外面这么吵，你睡得___吗？
en: It's so noisy outside; can you get to sleep?
I can't understand what the doctor says.
The rain is too heavy; we can't get back.
In such cold weather, can you sleep or not?
You must not drink alcohol while taking medicine.
I can't drink this much water at one time.
My hands are frozen stiff; I can't write the characters well.
I can't afford these glasses.
The fog is so thick that I can't see ahead.
I can't finish all these pills.
The doctor says you can't eat spicy food right now.
I can't find my umbrella.
task: Say you cannot find it.

en: His voice is too quiet; I can't hear him.
src: 他的声音很大，我听得见。
task: Say his voice is too quiet, so you cannot hear.

en: It's still raining; we can't walk back.
task: It is still raining: say you cannot walk back.

en: This sofa is too big; we can't move it in.
src: 这个沙发很小，我们搬得进去。
task: Say it is too big to be moved in.

en: These boots are too expensive; I can't afford them.
src: 这双靴子很便宜，我买得起。
task: Say it is too expensive, so you cannot afford it.

en: It is already too late to go to the hospital now.
task: Say it is already too late.

en: I can't go to school tomorrow.
task: Say you cannot go (you are ill).

en: We can't eat this many dishes.
task: Make it negative (cannot manage).

en: I've caught a cold, so I can't go to the seaside any more.
task: Say you caught a cold and are unable to go (not that you decided against it).

en: You can't look at your phone during the exam.
src: 考试的时候，你可以看手机。
task: Say it is not allowed.

en: The doctor says you can't leave the hospital.
task: Say the doctor says you are not allowed to leave hospital.

en: My leg hurts too much; I can't walk any further.
task: Say your leg hurts so much that you cannot walk any further.

en: His throat hurts; he can't sing well today.
task: Say his throat hurts, so he cannot sing well today.

en: He doesn't write Chinese characters well.
task: Say he does not write them well.

en: I can't explain this matter clearly.
src: 这个问题我说得很清楚。
task: Say you cannot explain it clearly.

en: I can't remember his name any more.
task: Use 想不起来 with the object after it.

en: I can't understand this article.
task: Say you cannot understand it; put the object after the verb block.

en: I can't understand the instructions for this medicine.
src: 我看不懂这个药的说明。
task: Put the object first as the topic.

en: I can't answer the teacher's question.
src: 老师的问题我回答不了。
task: Move the object after the verb block.

en: Can you hear me?
task: Make it a yes/no question with 吗.

en: Can you see the writing on the board clearly or not?
src: 黑板上的字你看得清楚。
task: Ask with the positive and negative forms side by side, no 吗.

en: Can you fall asleep?
task: Ask with the colloquial V不V得R pattern.

en: If we go now, will we make it in time?
task: Ask with 吗.

en: The snow is so heavy; can you drive?
task: Ask with 吗.

en: This road is so narrow; can a big vehicle get through or not?
src: 这条路这么窄，大车开得过去。
task: Ask with the positive and negative forms, no 吗.

s: 雾太大了，我们不看见路。
昨天雨声太大，我一句也没听清楚。
我的眼镜坏了，什么都看不得清楚。
他的名字我想起不来了。
雪太厚了，车开不出去。
山太高了，我们爬没上去。
这么贵的手机，我不买起。
这间教室坐得下六十个人。
雨下得太大，我们来不及得回家。
我感冒了，今天上不了班。
这么多菜，我们吃不了完。
那场大雪，我一辈子都忘不了。
我去不了了，你们去吧。
你感冒了，不能喝冰水。
他的汉字写不很好。
医生说得不清楚，所以我没听懂。
这个药名太长，我把它记不住。
我听他的话不懂。
你听得见不见？
雪这么厚，你们走不走得回去？
